---
title: Path to a usable v1
---

The existing-project connector works on macOS with a reviewed local renderer.
A dependable v1 should make that starting point clear and make installation,
first use and recovery reproducible for another person.

## Required before v1

1. **Complete native Windows acceptance.** Run the installed adapter with real
   Quarto, licensed fonts, watch saves, failure retention, recovery and shutdown.
   Unit tests alone do not establish this behavior.
2. **Provide a synthetic starter or settle the product boundary.** Either ship a
   supported renderer/template with clear licenses, or release explicitly as an
   existing-project connector. Today each user supplies a reviewed renderer.
3. **Make integration tests self-contained.** A synthetic project should exercise
   the renderer contract in CI without relying on anyone's private repository.
4. **Finish installation and adoption compatibility.** Test the wheel, minimum
   Python version, Windows/macOS paths and upgrades. Plan config/skill migrations
   as reviewable diffs while preserving customized project instructions.
5. **Reconcile the remaining local work before versioning a release.** Keep the
   useful QMD migration helpers separate from retired Word-first code. Confirm
   package/template licenses and choose a coherent version history.

## Next quality improvements

- Clear profile/config schemas and error examples; consistent validation of
  evidence references and conflicted or proposed facts.
- A repeatable output QA checklist covering text, links, font handling and pages,
  with honest Word pagination limits.
- Docs build/link checks and a reviewed distribution path. Publication and any
  public website deployment require a separate decision.

## Current verification {#verification}

The local prototype passed 16 synthetic package tests, ten applicable macOS
renderer fixture tests, and real installed-command Quarto build/watch acceptance.
Five Windows-only renderer cases were skipped on Mac.

Real résumé and CV checks were performed only in disposable private workspaces.
Direct and adapter PDF pixels, text and links matched; derived Word body,
relationships and styles matched. No private documents are included in this site.

The review branch adds native Windows/macOS unit CI. Its current check results
belong to the pull request. Complete Windows renderer acceptance remains pending.

There is no service, autonomous collector, database or automatic publication step
in this v1 plan. Career facts remain subject to the owner's review.
